integrity: The proof is self-contained; a finite checker independently verifies the stage-count recurrence and telescoping invariant on representative small parameter choices.
scientific_limitations: The recurrence describes the free zero-preserving expansion and finite term-depth generated hulls. Extra identities or nonfree specializations can only change the profile and are not covered.
title: Exact term-closure towers for zero-preserving generic functions on finite-field vector spaces
